questions.question: You have received an email from your friend Sam about a new course you have started. Read Sam's email and the notes you have made. Write an email to Sam answering all the notes. (Target: 100 words). Notes: 1. Say which course it is. 2. Explain why you chose it. 3. Mention the teacher. 4. Ask Sam about their plans.
questions.explanation: This is a writing task requiring a response to four specific points in an email format.

questions.question: Choose ONE of the following tasks. 1. Write an article titled 'Learning something new' for your school magazine. 2. Write a story that begins with the sentence: 'It was my first day at the class.' (Target: 100 words).
questions.explanation: This is a choice-based writing task requiring either a descriptive article or a narrative story.
